tool_input.description: List global built-ins and recent commits
Benchmark decode loop against a baseline loop

result: I implemented `decodeURIComponent` in its own file and added the spec's `Decode` operation there as a private helper, since no shared version exists yet. `decodeURI` will need the same helper, so it should move to `kahvi_core::ops` when that ticket lands. `./t262 built-ins/decodeURIComponent/` gives 110 of 112 runs passing, with 2 timeouts (`S15.1.3.2_A2.5_T1.js`, sloppy and strict). That test makes about a million calls in a debug build, so I believe the timeouts come from interpreter speed rather than this code, but I did not confirm that. `cargo clippy` is clean and the diff touches only the one file.
